caption: The drawing features a central, realistic depiction of a metallic pedestal dish or compote, likely silver or pewter, characterized by a wide, shallow bowl and a narrow, flared stem that widens out at the base. The colors are primarily shades of gray with white highlights, capturing the reflective quality of the metal. The dish is shown in a three-dimensional, slightly elevated view, with careful attention to light and shadow. Below the main image are two square sections: the left section contains a simple line drawing of the dish in profile, and the right section shows a line drawing of the top view, featuring an inscription within two concentric circles that reads "DANIEL LOW & CO. PEWTER MADE IN USA 02534." The name "Carmel Wilson" is written below the central image. The drawing is rendered on a light, cream-colored background.
title: Pewter Compote
